## Has Haaland reached 300 goals?

Yes — and he got there faster than any other active superstar. Erling Haaland scored his 300th career goal for club and country during Manchester City’s Club World Cup match against Juventus, as reported by ESPN (sports news outlet). He hit the mark in just 370 senior appearances.

...

## How many goals has Haaland in total?

Breaking down the full tally by club and country shows where the goals come from and how consistent his output has been since his senior debut.

|Team / Context |Games |Goals |Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|Molde |50 |20 |Manchester City (official club site) |
|Red Bull Salzburg |27 |29 |Manchester City (official club site) |
|Borussia Dortmund |89 |86 |Manchester City (official club site) |
|Manchester City |89 |115 |Manchester City (official club site) |
|Norway (international) |48 |55 |Wikipedia (encyclopedia entry) |
|**Career total (as of 2025)** |**~370** |**over 300** |ESPN (sports news outlet) |

### International record: Norway’s all-time top scorer

Haaland became Norway’s all-time leading scorer in 2025, with 55 goals in 48 senior appearances, according to Wikipedia (encyclopedia entry). That is a rate of over 1.
1 goals per game at international level — extraordinary for a country that has never qualified for a major tournament during his career.

Haaland also ranks among the fastest to 40 Champions League goals, needing just 35 games to reach that mark, as reported by Manchester City (official club site). He now has 47 goals in 47 Champions League appearances, placing him joint-13th on the competition’s all-time scoring list.

**Bottom line:** Haaland’s goals-per-game ratio across all competitions exceeds 0.8. That places him in a tier with the most efficient scorers in football history. For defenders, the message is sobering: his output does not dip between leagues or competitions.

The data confirms Haaland’s elite efficiency across all levels — a record that few can match.

## Who has more goals, Haaland or Mbappé?

The Haaland versus Mbappé debate is the defining attacking comparison of this generation. Here is the data on where each stands.

|Metric |Erling Haaland |Kylian Mbappé |
| --- | --- | --- |
|Born |2000 |1998 |
|Total career goals |over 300 |higher total (earlier start) |
|Games to reach 300 goals |370 |409 (ESPN (sports news outlet)) |
|Goals-per-game ratio (club) |~0.81 |~0.65 (estimated) |
|International goals |55 in 48 caps |~50+ in 80+ caps |
|Champions League goals |47 in 47 games (Manchester City (official club site)) |~50+ in ~75 games |

The pattern: Mbappé holds the edge in raw volume because he started his senior career earlier, but Haaland leads in efficiency across nearly every metric. His goals-per-game rate in the Champions League is better than anyone else in the top 50 scorers, according to Manchester City (official club site).

Why this matters

If both players maintain their current trajectories, Haaland’s higher efficiency means he could overtake Mbappé’s total goal count within two to three seasons, despite the age gap. The race may hinge not on talent but on longevity and injury prevention.
The implication: Haaland’s efficiency gives him a path to surpass Mbappé’s total, provided he stays healthy.

## Who is Man City’s top scorer all time?

Sergio Aguero holds Manchester City’s all-time scoring record with 260 goals across all competitions. Haaland is not there yet, but he is climbing the list at an unprecedented pace.

Haaland reached 100 goals for Manchester City in just 105 games, as reported by Manchester City (official club site). By comparison, Aguero took 147 games to reach his first 100 for the club. Haaland’s rate of nearly a goal per game is roughly 40% faster than the club’s previous benchmark.

|Player |Total goals for Man City |Games to 100 goals |
| --- | --- | --- |
|Sergio Aguero |260 (all-time record) |147 |
|Erling Haaland |115 (as of 2025) |105 (Manchester City (official club site)) |

...

95 m frame, while an asset in the box, adds load on joints and muscles over a long career.

**Bottom line:** Based on current data, Haaland could reach 1000 goals by his mid-30s if he maintains form and avoids major injuries. That is a very big “if.” For fans and analysts, the question is not whether he has the talent, but whether his body will cooperate long enough.

The catch: the second 700 goals are historically more difficult as athletic decline sets in, per ESPN (sports news outlet).

## Timeline: Haaland’s career milestones

* **2018-2020** — Played for Red Bull Salzburg, scoring 29 goals in 27 appearances (Manchester City (official club site))
* **2019** — Senior international debut for Norway (Wikipedia (encyclopedia entry))
* **2020-2022** — Joined Borussia Dortmund, scored 86 goals in 89 matches (Manchester City (official club site))
* **2022** — Transferred to Manchester City
* **2022-2025** — Became Premier League top scorer, reached 100 City goals in 105 games (Manchester City (official club site))
* **2025** — Scored 300th career goal against Juventus (Club World Cup); became Norway’s all-time top scorer (55 goals) (ESPN (sports news outlet); Wikipedia (encyclopedia entry))

The upshot

Haaland went from a promising teenager at Molde to the fastest scorer in modern football history in roughly seven seasons. His trajectory, measured in goals per game, has no direct precedent among active players.

The pattern: consistent acceleration at each club — a sign of a player who raises his game with each step up.

## What is confirmed — and what remains unclear

### Confirmed facts

* Haaland has scored over 300 career goals (ESPN (sports news outlet))
* He reached 300 goals in 370 matches, faster than Messi, Ronaldo, and Mbappé (ESPN (sports news outlet))
* He is Norway’s all-time top scorer with 55 goals in 48 appearances (Wikipedia (encyclopedia entry))
* His height is 1.95 m (Wikipedia (encyclopedia entry))
* He scored 100 goals for Manchester City in 105 games (Manchester City (official club site))
* He has 47 Champions League goals in 47 appearances (Manchester City (official club site))

### What remains unclear

* Whether Haaland can reach 1000 career goals — the pace is there, but longevity is unproven
